Title: View and navigate through changes across multiple resources

Body.Content:
Application Change Analysis feature of Azure Monitor now supports changes across multiple Azure resources. Let’s say your web app was working a few hours ago and suddenly started throwing errors. Instead of having to select a resource group and a resource, you can now narrow down which resource to investigate based on the number of changes, last changed timestamp, keyword search and so on. Old and new values are displayed in line for single property changes to provide all data at one glance. Click into a change to view more context in the full JSON view. Check out the experience at Application Change Analysis portal.

Learn more.
